title: 持续高温干旱重创欧洲农业
title_en: Sustained heat and drought batter European agriculture
summary: 今年入夏以来，欧洲持续高温少雨，农业遭受重创。欧盟及英国约半数土地遭遇不同程度干旱，9%达“警报”级别，法国、德国、匈牙利、罗马尼亚和英国旱情集中，卢瓦尔河、波河、莱茵河、多瑙河水位极低。欧盟多种作物单产预期下调，玉米和向日葵降6%至7%，
summary_en: Since the start of summer this year, Europe has experienced persistent high temperatures and low rainfall, dealing a severe blow to agriculture. About half of the land in the EU and the UK has been hit by varying degrees of drought, with 9% at 'alert' level. Drought conditions are concentrated in France, Germany, Hungary, Romania, and the UK, with the Loire, Po, Rhine, and Danube rivers at extremely low water levels. The EU has lowered yield expectations for multiple crops, with corn and sunflower down 6% to 7%.

title: 印度尼西亚全力开展抗震救灾
title_en: Indonesia goes all out in earthquake relief
summary: 印度尼西亚弗洛勒斯岛附近海域7.7级强震及余震已造成72人死亡、898人受伤，8.2万余人被分散安置，7968栋房屋和744处公共设施受损。截至8月20日凌晨已记录3394次余震，预计三四周后平息。地震引发海啸预警、山体滑坡和交通通信中断。
summary_en: A 7.7-magnitude earthquake and aftershocks near Indonesia's Flores Island have killed 72 people, injured 898, displaced over 82,000, and damaged 7,968 houses and 744 public facilities. As of early August 20, 3,394 aftershocks had been recorded and are expected to subside in three to four weeks. The quake triggered tsunami warnings, landslides, and disruptions to transport and communications.

summary_en: US President Trump said on social media that he wants to 'significantly reduce' the scale of US-South Korea joint military exercises. He said the exercises are hugely expensive, with a large share borne by the US, and send a 'completely inappropriate and hostile signal' to North Korea. Trump said that given his 'very good relationship' with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, he was surprised the United States agreed to participate in these exercises long ago.

title: “全球发展伙伴关系的生动实践”（共创繁荣发展新时代）
title_en: "A Vivid Practice of Global Development Partnership" (Creating a New Era of Prosperity and Development)
summary: 中国乡村发展基金会在尼泊尔发起国际微笑儿童项目，已覆盖20多个市、近200所学校。项目通过每日提供营养餐、升级厨房设施、培训学生母亲组成“妈妈团”负责烹饪等举措，改善低收入家庭儿童营养与学习状态。项目实施后，相关学校学生出勤率提高、辍学率下
summary_en: The China Foundation for Rural Development launched the International Smiling Children Project in Nepal, which has covered more than 20 cities and nearly 200 schools. The project improves the nutritional and learning status of children from low-income families through measures such as providing daily nutritious meals, upgrading kitchen facilities, and training students' mothers to form a “Mothers' Group” responsible for cooking. After the project was implemented, student attendance rates at relevant schools increased and dropout rates declined

title: 习近平致电祝贺希奇莱马当选连任赞比亚总统
title_en: Xi Jinping congratulates Hichilema on re-election as Zambian President
summary: 习近平致电祝贺希奇莱马当选连任赞比亚总统。习近平指出，近年来双方两次会晤，共同引领中赞关系发展，两国政治互信持续深化，务实合作成果丰硕，并在多边事务中密切协调配合。他表示高度重视中赞关系，愿同希奇莱马总统一道努力，落实中非合作论坛北京峰会成
summary_en: Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Hichilema on his re-election as President of Zambia. Xi noted that in recent years the two sides have met twice, jointly steering the development of China-Zambia relations, deepening political mutual trust, achieving fruitful practical cooperation, and closely coordinating in multilateral affairs. He said he highly values China-Zambia relations and is willing to work with President Hichilema to implement the outcomes of the Beijing Summit of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation.

title: 我国与10个APEC经济体实现AEO互认
title_en: China achieves AEO mutual recognition with 10 APEC economies
summary: 记者从亚太经合组织（APEC）“经认证的经营者”（AEO）专题研讨会获悉，除巴布亚新几内亚外，APEC经济体均已建立并实施AEO制度，中国海关已与其中10个经济体实现互认。据中国海关统计，今年1—7月，我国AEO企业进出口额16.76万亿元
summary_en: The reporter learned from the APEC 'Authorized Economic Operator' (AEO) thematic seminar that except Papua New Guinea, all APEC economies have established and implemented AEO systems, and China Customs has achieved mutual recognition with 10 of them. According to China Customs statistics, in the first seven months of this year, China's AEO enterprises' import and export value reached 16.76 trillion yuan.

title_en: Helping Bangladesh optimize its power mix and economic development
summary: 近年来，中国企业在孟加拉国投资建设多个清洁能源项目。科克斯巴扎尔风电项目是孟首个集中式风电项目，2023年10月投产，满足10万户家庭用电，并培养首批风电实操人才，计划打造风光储综合智慧能源基地。迈门辛光伏项目2020年投运，使用约17万块
summary_en: In recent years, Chinese enterprises have invested in and built several clean energy projects in Bangladesh. The Cox's Bazar wind power project is Bangladesh's first centralized wind power project, put into operation in October 2023. It supplies electricity to 100,000 households and has trained the country's first group of wind power operation personnel, with plans to build an integrated smart energy base combining wind, solar and storage. The Mymensingh photovoltaic project began operation in 2020, using about 170,000 solar panels.
